why: On 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-04 ten packages of a real project, some published since 2018, were released with the loader added, and npm removed the twelve releases within a day. The name alone is a legitimate package every user of a clean release depends on, so only the name and version together can be the indicator (ADR-0063). A lockfile that pins one resolved it, and the loader runs the moment the package is required.

findings.match: hijacked release of a real package installed

must_print: Change it to any other release
